sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Understanding the various sources of income is fundamental to financial literacy. Income can come from active sources like wages and salaries, as well as passive sources such as dividends and rental income.

sections.heading: Active vs Passive Income
sections.text:
Active income is earned through direct effort. Passive income continues to flow with minimal ongoing work.

Active Income:
- Wages and Salaries
- Freelancing and Gig Work

Passive Income:
- Dividends
- Rental Income

sections.heading: The Power of Diversification
sections.text:
Relying on a single income source is risky. Diversification helps create financial stability.

- Gig Economy
- Skill Monetization
- Investing Early
